question.text: The aggregate demand formula under the Expenditure Method is:

answer.text: GDP = Private Consumption + Government Spending + Gross Capital Formation + Net Exports

explanation.text: The Logic: Aggregate demand = C (private consumption) + G (government spending) + I (gross capital formation) + NX (net exports = exports - imports). The Trap: The other formulas represent Product Method (sector-wise), Income Method (factor income), and an incorrect trade formula. Cross-Exam Context: GDP formula tested in NISM Series XV and X-A.
